title: Chapter 298: Treasures Cannot Be Used
content:
Chapter 298: Treasures Cannot Be Used

boom!

As soon as he finished speaking, the man's face was distorted instantly, and his whole body was blown away like a shrimp-shaped bow.

At this moment, the scene is slashed.

"Brother Ye Quan!"

When the other Leaf people saw this scene, they were shocked and angry, and then they stared at the person who took action in front of them with resentment, with murderous intent in their eyes surging.

"You are seeking death when you attack me Ye people!"

And the person who took action was naturally Xiao Luo.

Xiao Luo then shook his hand, looked at the Ye people in front of him, snorted coldly, and said, "Ye Clan? I am fighting Ye Clan!"

Immediately, Xiao Luo rushed up to the several Ye people in front of him again.

Seeing this, Lu Xue no longer hesitated, "Qin Feng, go ahead and fuck them to death!"

Qin Feng naturally did not hesitate about this.

He took the sword decisively and went up to do it.

Immediately, Lu Xue, with Ao Qing and Qin Feng, rushed directly towards the terrified Ye people.

With the strength of Xiao Luo and Qin Feng, facing these titular Ye tribes, they almost crushed them. Soon, the only Ye tribes were left with the Ye tribes named Ye Quan. Alive.

Seeing Xiao Luo and his others surrounding him, the fear in his eyes almost turned into reality.

"Aren't you afraid of my Ye tribe's revenge?"

While he was afraid, he was very puzzled. Do these people have a grudge against their Ye tribe?

When I heard that they were from the Ye tribe, I suddenly became so fierce.

When you heard Ye Quan's words, Xiao Luo sneered: "When you were besieging me, Xiao clan, you didn't think of our Xiao clan's revenge?"

Xiao clan!

Hearing the words Xiao clan, Ye Quan suddenly reacted, and his face changed suddenly.

"You are from the Xiao clan!"

He seemed to growl, his whole body trembling slightly.

This is what he feared the most before entering the ancient battlefield.

The Ye tribe was not afraid of anyone in the ancient battlefield, but only the Xiao tribe.

After all, the strength of the Xiao clan is really terrifying now.

If it weren't for the ancestors of the clan, I'm afraid the Xiao clan would have been able to destroy their Ye clan.

But fortunately, the Xiao clan is only strong in top combat power, while the middle and lower classes are far inferior to the other three clans.

But now, he actually met the Xiao clan on the ancient battlefield, and he was such a powerful Xiao clan member.

With a plop, Ye Quan sat on the dirty ground with his butt, his eyes full of despair.

He knew that even begging for mercy at this moment would be useless.

The Xiao clan and them are almost mortal enemies, with no room for anything.

When Xiao Luo saw this, he stopped talking nonsense.

He punched Ye Quan directly in the head.

The sound of breaking through the air sounded.

Ye Quan's head exploded, adding a bit of blood to the bright red earth.

"Sister Xue, it's solved."

Xiao Luo walked calmly to Lu Xue and said with a little respect.

Hearing this, Lu Xue just nodded faintly, without even looking at it, her eyes always on the giant sword that was commonplace in front of her.

Qin Feng next to him is no exception.

Only Ao Qing lay on Lu Xue's shoulder, as if dozing off.

For him, only food can attract his attention.

"Qin Feng, what did you see?"

After watching for a long time, Lu Xue didn't see anything from the giant sword, and then asked Qin Feng beside her.

After all, although Qin Feng likes to show off, he really learns swordsmanship.

In terms of swords, it must be much better than me as a half-baked person.

Hearing Lu Xue’s question, Qin Feng’s face looked slightly solemn, “This sword is extraordinary.”

Lu Xue:...

"Aren't you talking nonsense?"

Lu Xue shook her head and then took out her Xuanyuan Sword.

However, when the Xuanyuan Sword appeared in her hands, her face suddenly changed.

"This, what's going on, Xuanyuan Sword?"

Lu Xue's eyes were full of disbelief and she shook the Xuanyuan Sword in her hand with force.

At this moment, the Xuanyuan Sword emits its unique golden sacred light. The sword body is engraved with sun, moon, mountains, rivers, and mountains, rivers, and mountains, rivers, and trees. The dragon patterns are entangled at the hilt of the sword, and each part reveals extraordinaryness.

After all, after all, this Xuanyuan Sword was caught by Lu Daosheng himself from the system store, so how could it be an ordinary thing?

Qin Feng looked at the Xuanyuan Sword in Lu Xue's hand. Even though it was not the first time he saw him, his expression was still solemn.

He is a sword cultivator and can deeply feel the terrifying sword energy emitted by the Xuanyuan Sword and the magnificent power of the heavenly power like the human emperor.

Facing it, it seems like looking directly at the Human Emperor, deeply feeling his own insignificance.

"Sister Xue, is there something wrong?"

At this time, Xiao Luo said a little puzzled.

Lu Xue looked at the Xuanyuan Sword in her hand and said in a deep voice: "The sword spirit is gone."

Sword Spirit?

As we all know, whether it is a magic weapon or a weapon, it will produce spirits when it reaches a certain level.

A divine object of the Xuanyuan Sword level naturally has spirits.

Moreover, Xuanyuan Sword has automatically protected the master more than once.

But now, Lu Xue can't feel the sword spirit anymore.

"Uh, could you fall asleep?"

Ao Qing opened his sleepy eyes at this time and said in a daze.

Hearing this, Lu Xue looked ugly, "Do you think everyone is the same as you."

At this time, Qin Feng looked up at the giant sword in front of him and said slightly solemnly: "That's not that he was scared by this sword and dared not come out."

"impossible!"

As soon as these words were spoken, Lu Xue directly refuted.

"This sword was given to me by my father, how could I be scared by other swords?"

The Xuanyuan Sword scared it almost the same.

As he said that, Lu Xue actually waved the Xuanyuan Sword and slashed the giant sword in front of him.

bite!

A crisp metal collision sounded.

The Xuanyuan Sword was intact, but there was a big gap in the giant sword.

Sure enough, Xuanyuan Sword is slightly better.

Then why did the Xuanyuan Sword Spirit disappear?

Lu Xue pondered that she could not think of anyone else who could make the Xuanyuan Sword Spirit have problems except her father.

Could it be a real dad?

Lu Xue had a guess in her mind, and then she suddenly looked at her storage ring.

The next moment, countless dazzling treasures appeared in front of Lu Xue, almost piled up into a small hill.

Seeing this scene, Xiao Luo and Qin Feng on the side had their mouths so big that they could stuff an egg.

There are so many treasures they have never seen in their lifetime.

There are ancient bells, small towers, lotus flowers, and beads of different sizes.

There are countless things, and every one is placed outside, it is a peerless treasure that can cause storm waves and make countless people crazy.

But at this moment, these were piled up on this dirty land like garbage.

Looking at the treasures piled up in front of him, Lu Xue's eyes were slightly red.

In addition to a single column, all treasures lost their former light and became dull.

"Dad, you are so petty!"

Lu Xue whistled to the sky, venting the anger in her heart.

Now, I don’t even let myself use the treasure.

I'm really not afraid that she will lose her mind.
